class_groups_dates_check.name: class_groups_dates_check
class_groups_dates_check.value: "class_groups"."status" = 'draft' or ("class_groups"."starts_on" is not null and "class_groups"."ends_on" is not null)

class_groups_enrollment_window_check.name: class_groups_enrollment_window_check
class_groups_enrollment_window_check.value: "class_groups"."enrollment_opens_at" is null or "class_groups"."enrollment_closes_at" is null or "class_groups"."enrollment_opens_at" < "class_groups"."enrollment_closes_at"

courses_landing_key_live_uidx.name: courses_landing_key_live_uidx
courses_landing_key_live_uidx.where: "courses"."landing_key" is not null and "courses"."deleted_at" is null

email_verifications_consumed_check.name: email_verifications_consumed_check
email_verifications_consumed_check.value: "email_verifications"."consumed_at" is null or "email_verifications"."verified_at" is not null

payments_decided_by_check.name: payments_decided_by_check
payments_decided_by_check.value: "decided_by" is null or "decided_at" is not null

receipt_uploads_screen_pending_idx.name: receipt_uploads_screen_pending_idx
receipt_uploads_screen_pending_idx.where: "receipt_uploads"."status" = 'processed' and "receipt_uploads"."payment_id" is not null and "receipt_uploads"."screened_at" is null

receipt_uploads_validate_pending_idx.name: receipt_uploads_validate_pending_idx
receipt_uploads_validate_pending_idx.where: "receipt_uploads"."payment_id" is not null and "receipt_uploads"."screened_at" is not null and "receipt_uploads"."validated_at" is null

staff_invites_teacher_check.name: staff_invites_teacher_check
staff_invites_teacher_check.value: ("staff_invites"."teacher_id" is null or "staff_invites"."role" = 'teacher') and ("staff_invites"."role" <> 'teacher' or "staff_invites"."status" <> 'pending' or "staff_invites"."teacher_id" is not null)

teacher_contracts_file_check.name: teacher_contracts_file_check
teacher_contracts_file_check.value: ("teacher_contracts"."object_key" is null) = ("teacher_contracts"."file_name" is null) and ("teacher_contracts"."object_key" is null) = ("teacher_contracts"."file_size_bytes" is null)

teacher_contracts_source_check.name: teacher_contracts_source_check
teacher_contracts_source_check.value: "teacher_contracts"."object_key" is not null or "teacher_contracts"."template_version_id" is not null
